correctness.rationale: For each prime, writing \(a_i=p^t b_i\) with minimal normalized valuation zero gives exactly \(v_p(f_k)=\min((k-1)t+\sum_i v_p(b_i),v_p(\sum_i b_i))\). This yields a complete local dichotomy. The finite-field zero-sum count follows from additive-character orthogonality; summing the positive common-valuation layers gives the final geometric-series term. Finite-prime conditions are obtained as limits of CRT cylinder sets, and the two possible large-prime obstructions have vanishing upper density by explicit union bounds. The local complement is \(O_k(p^{-2})\), proving positivity and convergence. Exact finite replay corroborates all algebraic reductions without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result resolves a natural extension explicitly posed by the motivating paper rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. It identifies the higher-dimensional structural obstruction: primitive tuples may have a prime dividing both product and sum, measured by an exact finite-field zero-sum count, while common p-adic scaling contributes a separate geometric layer. The theorem gives a closed local factor for every fixed dimension, recovers the established pair result exactly, and produces the first concrete cubic density within this framework.
